name: Firearm Bullet
summary: Ammunition for Muskets and Pistols; sold 10 at a time.
text: One piece of ammunition for Muskets and Pistols. A bundle of 10 costs 3 GP and weighs 2 lb.; it is usually kept in a Pouch, bought separately. Each attack with an Ammunition weapon uses one piece. After a fight, spending 1 minute lets you recover half of the pieces you used (round down); the rest are lost.
